summary_1line: Night battle: Vrishasena wounds Drupada; Duhsasana disables Prativindhya; Nakula defeats and routs Sakuni before moving toward Drona.

image_candidates.scene_text: Under scattered lamps at night, Vrishasena's arrow pierces Drupada's chest as the wounded king slumps in his chariot.
Nakula and Sakuni stand in their chariots bristling with arrows like porcupines, armor shattered and bodies blood-soaked.
Sakuni collapses on his chariot clutching the fallen flagstaff after Nakula's arrows strike his thigh.
